display_name: 冻结 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 指导的直接 IQ 恢复
description: 不依赖 DURA 的时域与时频直接网络；采用冻结地面基座的干净特征和软预测指导源域训练，结合 IQ 保护及源验证筛选。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python GPU 3 if free; two CPU threads

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256]; source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated post_sync residual channel
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Six registered Phase1 TX; no TX labels used in training or source IQ selection
data.validation_ref: 4096 fixed sampled L_s/U_s IDs, rx4/6 day3 source validation and rx8 day3 exploratory heldout, all three receiver/day groups excluded from training; no V
data.leo_config_ref: Fixed source cache epochs 11-15 training and epoch20 validation; seven Phase1 practical scenes

permissions.query_use: No target data until all source selection fixed; then seven-view predictions before truth; no Phase3
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed, source heldout and Phase1 development previously observed, no independent-blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed direct IQ source parent epoch10; Tri-SIG-TIME SSL frozen throughout; DURA absent from network and training
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: core.data checks physical IDs against Tri-SIG-TIME roles; parent commit exact
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: High confidence clean frozen F pseudo labels and paired source IQ only, RX4/6 day3; epochs1/3/5 and alpha .25/.5/1; per-cell classification guard, IQ guard and >=2 impaired net gain; retain raw if no candidate; RX8 heldout excluded from selection

execution.launch_owner: Codex direct semantic source single owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU3 only if idle; one worker, two CPU threads

execution.stop_rule: Only provenance/role violation, output collision, nonfinite or technical execution failure; preserve all partial outputs; no stop for low performance

dimensions: receiver day heldout source teacher agreement
TX RX day on post-prediction scorer
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Goal six scenario accuracies versus clean ground SSL <=3 pp and also <=3% relative, clean protection, no blind claim.

rows.method: direct IQ temporal-spectral attention with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL output/feature distillation and source IQ regularization; no DURA dependency
rows.purpose: source-selected direct IQ improvement then Phase1 test
rows.seed_notes: Fixed prior parent source split and cache epochs 11-15/20; model seed 2026110854 and shuffle seed 2026110855; no target-derived seed
rows.scenario: seven source scenes and seven final Phase1 views if selected
rows.budget_ref: 47143 source training IDs, batch32, five source epochs

notes: Frozen F clean soft outputs and features guide training; no ground truth TX labels or U_s true labels, V or target IQ used during training and selection.
